page.layout: One page of verse, one block of text; running head at top centre; page number at top right; a printed ornament and a small signature-like letter "F" below the text. No margin notes.

main_text.p:
Viderit vultu facili, rogare
Ne nouo certus renuas Parenti
Sponsor adesse:
Quum recens sacris puer abluetur
Fontibus Christi: capietque ab illo
Nomen aeterna Monadis rigatus
Nomine trino.

Nam suae Christus bonitatis olim
Symbolum puris gregibus reliquit
Tale, quum sponsam proprio redeunt
Sanguine charam.

Atque primorum veteres parentum
Sustulit culpas meritamque mortem,
Vt prius clausum referaret alti
Limen Olympi.

Si volens, Lecti, tribuis quod opto,
Quos amor Musae similis sodales
Fecerat dudum potiora posthac
Foedera iungent.

page.notes: Printed ornament (decorative tailpiece) between the text and the foot; a small letter "F" above it, probably a signature mark. Show-through from the reverse page is present and was left out. Text is set in italic throughout; the verse lines were written as printed, with the italic type not shown in tags for each line.
